basis: rg --files kit docs templates scenarios demos vault, including current untracked non-ignored files
review_method: Enumerated paths and directory coverage; read canonical contracts and task entrances; sampled active Kit, historical receipts, project-stage drafts, source catalog entrances and metadata; checked selected status and link references by targeted search. This is not line-by-line review of all 1339 files.

excluded_from_file_level_editorial_revie.generated_or_project_specific_distilled_: Rendered HTML/PDF, motion output, images and implementation source inspected only through their entrances and selected lifecycle references.
excluded_from_file_level_editorial_revie.note: These exclusions are from line-by-line editorial assessment, not from boundary, entrance or lifecycle inventory. Source repository copies and original Chat text were not treated as instructions.

known_parallel_change: Before this audit, answer.html and answer.pdf were renamed or deleted by other work. Approximately 40 links in the repository still point to those old names; this audit reports the entire transition as one grouped finding, not 40 findings.
verification: No full repository validator run in this audit; parent agent owns final validation. No external source or dependency was fetched.
